name: case1_phone
goal: Case 1 roll & scan with the handheld scanner: the left arm rolls the label-down bag label-up; the left claw opens 5 s for the phone, grips it; the left arm holds the phone over the bag until it decodes the label; the harness routes the code; the right arm picks the bag up; WALLX (right arm) puts it into the scanned zone; the harness confirms at the box, releases, homes; the left arm keeps the phone.
setup: White mailer bag label DOWN on the scenario 3 marks (middle, between the boxes). Phone ready (scanner page open, Start camera, 3x). Arms at rest. Put the phone into the left claw when it opens (after the flip).
